title: Tillu, Golu & Pinky's Silly Jungle Day
description: Tillu the monkey, Golu the bear, and Pinky the squirrel have a day of silly jungle adventures full of laughs and surprises.

scenes.description: wide shot of sunny jungle, monkey swinging, bear with picnic basket, squirrel hopping
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) sunny jungle, brown cartoon monkey wearing red scarf swinging on vines, brown bear in blue vest carrying picnic basket, small gray squirrel with green bow hopping, cartoon style
scenes.narration: जंगल में सुबह हो चुकी है, और तिल्लू, गोलू और पिंकी पिकनिक के लिए निकल पड़े हैं।
scenes.subtitle: A Sunny Start

scenes.description: close-up of monkey dropping bananas while laughing
scenes.visual_prompt: close-up cartoon brown monkey wearing red scarf laughing, bananas falling, bright jungle background
scenes.narration: तिल्लू हंसते-हंसते केले गिरा देता है।
scenes.subtitle: Banana Trouble

scenes.description: medium shot of bear slipping on banana peel
scenes.visual_prompt: medium shot cartoon brown bear in blue vest slipping on banana peel, green jungle background
scenes.narration: गोलू केले पकड़ने की कोशिश करता है, लेकिन खुद ही फिसल जाता है।
scenes.subtitle: Slippery Situation

scenes.description: wide shot of squirrel running to colorful bush
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) small gray squirrel with green bow running to rainbow-colored bush in jungle clearing, cartoon style
scenes.narration: पिंकी को एक रंग-बिरा झाड़ी दिखाई देती है।
scenes.subtitle: The Mysterious Bush

scenes.description: medium shot of friends peeking into bush
scenes.visual_prompt: medium shot cartoon brown monkey with red scarf, brown bear in blue vest, gray squirrel with green bow peeking into rainbow-colored bush, cartoon jungle style
scenes.narration: तीनों झाड़ी के अंदर झांकते हैं और हंसने लगते हैं।
scenes.subtitle: Peek-a-Bush

scenes.description: close-up of frogs with flower hats jumping out
scenes.visual_prompt: close-up small green frogs wearing colorful flower hats jumping out of bush, bright cartoon jungle style
scenes.narration: अंदर छोटे-छोटे मेंढक फूलों की टोपी पहने नाच रहे हैं।
scenes.subtitle: Dancing Frogs

scenes.description: wide shot of friends dancing with frogs
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) cartoon brown monkey with red scarf, brown bear in blue vest, gray squirrel with green bow dancing with green frogs wearing flower hats in jungle clearing
scenes.narration: तीनों दोस्तों ने मेंढकों के साथ नाचना शुरू कर दिया।
scenes.subtitle: Dance Party

scenes.description: medium shot of bear knocking picnic basket
scenes.visual_prompt: medium shot cartoon brown bear in blue vest accidentally knocking picnic basket, fruit spilling out, cartoon jungle style
scenes.narration: नाचते-नाचते गोलू ने टोकरी गिरा दी।
scenes.subtitle: Picnic Spill

scenes.description: close-up of friends sharing food with frogs
scenes.visual_prompt: close-up cartoon brown monkey with red scarf, brown bear in blue vest, gray squirrel with green bow sharing fruit with green frogs in flower hats, cartoon jungle style
scenes.narration: सबने मिलकर खाना बांटा और खूब हंसी-मजाक किया।
scenes.subtitle: Sharing is Fun

scenes.description: wide shot of sunset, friends waving goodbye to frogs
scenes.visual_prompt: (wide shot) cartoon brown monkey with red scarf, brown bear in blue vest, gray squirrel with green bow waving to green frogs wearing flower hats under orange sunset in jungle
scenes.narration: शाम हो गई, और तीनों दोस्तों ने मेंढकों को अलविदा कहा।
scenes.subtitle: Goodbye Frogs
